title: gadget.json: a shiny-trinkets gadget manifest
description: Describes one gadget (gadgets/<id>/gadget.json). tools/trinket check validates the parts that need the rest of the repo (unique ids and ports, hosts, files).

kind.description: gadget: an app here; service: something with its own page; background: no page.

host.description: A key of hosts in registry/site.json (pc, pi).

desc.description: One line, for tiles and the menu.

about.description: A few sentences for the Cards view.

icon.description: Path of its icon (SVG) inside the folder. Default icon.svg.

proxy.description: Served through the registry on its own port.

upstream.description: How the registry reaches it, e.g. http://my-gadget:8080 (the gadgets network).

protocols.description: Narrow the site's protocols; default both.

nav.description: The navbar injected into its pages.

url.description: Instead of proxy: a page served elsewhere. Write a host's address as {pc} (filled in from registry/site.local.json).

pages.description: One app, several tools: each page shows up as a gadget of its own.

intents.description: "I want to…" phrases that lead here.

phrase.description: Finishes "I want to": "…cut a bit out of a longer video".

group.description: A key of groups in registry/site.json.

page.description: Open this page of the gadget.

uses.description: Gadgets or services it talks to.

name.description: Portainer stack name (found by name, not number).

compose.description: Compose file, relative to the gadget folder.

go.description: Cross-compile a Go binary on the build box first (for the Pi).

secrets.description: Environment values a new stack needs (from ~/.config/shiny-trinkets/<stack>.env).

glyph.description: SVG markup on a 64×64 grid; {S} = white stroke, {F} = white fill.
